title: How to Grill Whole Zucchini on a Non-Stick BBQ Grill Mat
keyword: grilled zucchini on a grill mat
meta_description: Learn how to grill whole zucchini on a non-stick BBQ grill mat for perfect texture and flavor. Step‑by‑step tips, seasoning ideas, and cleanup tricks.
html:
Grilling whole zucchini on a grill mat is a foolproof way to get those sweet, smoky specks without the veggies falling through the grates. The non‑stick surface of a BBQ Grill Mat protects delicate foods from flare‑ups and sticking, so you can focus on flavor instead of rescue missions.

Why Use a Grill Mat for Zucchini?

Even the most seasoned grill‑master knows that zucchini’s high water content can cause it to stick or tear on a bare grill. A reusable non‑stick mat creates a flat, even cooking surface, preventing the squash from slipping through the grates while still allowing the smoky char you love.

Preparing the Zucchini

Start with fresh, firm zucchini. Cut off the ends, then slice each squash lengthwise into halves or quarters—depending on size. Keeping the pieces whole (instead of diced) helps retain moisture and gives you those beautiful grill marks.

  • Rinse and pat dry; excess moisture hinders browning.
  • Brush both sides lightly with olive oil.
  • Season with salt, pepper, and any herbs you like—thyme, rosemary, or a pinch of smoked paprika works great.

If you prefer a sweet glaze, mix a tablespoon of honey with a splash of lemon juice and brush it on just before the last few minutes of cooking.

Setting Up Your Grill and Mat

Preheat the grill to medium‑high (about 400‑425°F). Place the BBQ Grill Mats directly on the pre‑heated grates; they will warm up within a minute. The mats are designed to withstand high heat, so there’s no need to spray them with oil.

Arrange the zucchini pieces in a single layer, cut side down, to maximize contact with the heat. Close the lid and let them sear for 3‑4 minutes.

Cooking Technique and Timing

After the initial sear, flip the zucchini and continue grilling for another 3‑4 minutes. The goal is a lightly charred exterior while the interior stays tender. Because the mat prevents direct flame contact, you’ll avoid the dreaded burnt spots that often happen with delicate vegetables.

For added flavor, toss a few minced garlic cloves onto the mat during the last minute of cooking. The mat’s non‑stick surface will keep the garlic from burning, releasing a gentle aroma that infuses the zucchini.

Finishing Touches and Serving Ideas

Remove the zucchini from the mat and let it rest for a minute. Drizzle with a splash of balsamic reduction or a sprinkle of grated Parmesan for an extra punch. These grilled zucchini on a grill mat make a fantastic side dish for steak, chicken, or a vegetarian main.

Leftovers can be chilled and tossed into a summer pasta salad or used as a topping for grain bowls. The mat’s easy‑clean nature means you won’t have to wrestle stuck bits off the grates—just wipe the mat clean and store it for the next cookout.

FAQ

Can I use the BBQ Grill Mat on a gas and charcoal grill?

Yes. The mat is heat‑resistant up to 500°F and works on any type of grill, making it a versatile accessory for all your outdoor cooking.

Do I need to oil the grill mat before cooking?

No. The mat’s non‑stick coating eliminates the need for additional oil. Just brush the zucchini itself with a little oil for flavor and grill.

How do I clean the grill mat after grilling zucchini?

Let the mat cool, then wipe it with a damp cloth or rinse it under warm water with a mild dish soap. It’s reusable and dries quickly, so it’s ready for your next grilling session.
